sentences.text: ORDER This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No. 61/2023 registered at Police Station Nanakheda, District Ujjain (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 376(2), 366 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
The applicant is in custody since 06.02.2023.
As per prosecution story, prosecutrix was a labourer and used to travel with the applicant for doing work wherever work of labourers are required.

On 05.02.2023 the prosecutrix lodged an FIR against the applicant Jitendra stating that two months before the applicant told her that some work of laborers are needed and, therefore, took her to Kanak hotel and committed repeatedly rape upon her and also threatened her that if she discloses the incident to anyone, he will kill her.

Accordingly,
offence has been registered against the applicant.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is an innocent person and he has been falsely implicated in this offence.
He is in custody since 06.02.2023.
Investigation is over and charge sheet has been filed.

sentences.text: 1 of 38 years old and medical evidence does not support the case of prosecution for commission of rape.
FIR had been lodged after one month delay from the date of the incident.
Applicant is permanent resident of District Ujjain.
Final conclusion of the trial is likely to take sufficient long time.
Under the above circumstances, it is prayed that applicant be enlarged on bail on such terms and conditions, as this Court deems fit and proper.

Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent / State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection by submitting that prosecutrix supported the FIR version in her statement under section 164 Cr.P.C. Perused the impugned order of the trial Court as well as the case diary.

After considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, nature and gravity of offence, arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the applicant and also taking note of the fact that prosecutrix is 38 years old major lady, MLC has not corroborated the prosecution case, investigation is over, applicant is in jail since 06.02.2023, and final conclusion of the trial will take sufficient long time.
In these circumstances, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.75,000/- (Rupees Seventy Five Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court, as and when required.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) Cr.P.C. Certified copy as per rules.
